sloka: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः ।। ७.८२.८ ॥
transliteration: tathā vadati kākutsthe vākyamadbhutadarśanam ।uvāca paramaprīto dharmanetrastapodhanaḥ ।। 7.82.8 ॥

translations.english: As Rama, whose words were of wonderful meaning, spoke thus, the sage Agastya, whose vision was righteousness and whose wealth was austerity, spoke, being extremely pleased.
